website.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
website.privacy.intro: {company} respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights.
website.privacy.s1.title: Who we are
website.privacy.s1.body: {company} is a platform specialising in sleep apnoea that connects patients with certified sleep specialists. We are the data controller for your personal data under GDPR.
website.privacy.s2.title: Data we collect
website.privacy.s2.body: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide: first and last name, phone number, email address, city, and information about your symptoms or treatment needs. For dental professionals, we also collect clinic details and tax identification number.
website.privacy.s3.title: How we use your data
website.privacy.s3.body: We use your data to match you with a certified specialist in your area, manage your enquiry, and communicate with you. The applicable legal basis depends on your jurisdiction: pre-contractual measures (GDPR Art. 6.1.b — EU; LFPDPPP Art. 9 — Mexico; PDPA — Thailand). For health data, we always rely on your explicit consent.
website.privacy.s4.title: Data sharing
website.privacy.s4.body: We share your data only with the certified specialist managing your case and with technical service providers under confidentiality agreements. We never sell or transfer your data for commercial purposes.
website.privacy.s5.title: Retention
website.privacy.s5.body: We retain your data for as long as necessary for the stated purpose, and at most 3 years from last contact. Data related to active treatment is retained for the duration of the relationship.
website.privacy.s6.title: Your rights
website.privacy.s6.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to, and port your data (GDPR — EU). In Mexico, you may also exercise ARCO rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, Opposition) under the LFPDPPP. In Thailand, equivalent rights apply under the PDPA. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}. You may also contact the relevant authority in your country: AEPD (Spain/EU), INAI (Mexico), or PDPC (Thailand).
website.privacy.s7.title: Cookies
website.privacy.s7.body: We only use essential technical cookies required for the site to function. We do not use third-party advertising cookies. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.
website.privacy.s8.title: Changes & contact
website.privacy.s8.body: We may update this policy occasionally. Significant changes will be communicated by email or via a notice on the website. For any privacy-related enquiries, contact us at {email}.
website.about.heroSub: NeoSleep bridges the science of dental sleep medicine with the patients who need it most — evidence-based, human-centered, built for lasting results.
website.about.mission.body: Millions suffer silently from sleep apnea — a condition that quietly undermines heart health, cognitive performance, and quality of life. We built NeoSleep to change that. Our platform connects certified dental professionals with patients through evidence-based, non-invasive oral appliance therapy. Every protocol, every feature, every interaction is grounded in peer-reviewed research and shaped by the lived experiences of our patients and clinicians.

website.help.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
website.help.faq.q1.a: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a sleep disorder in which the throat muscles intermittently relax and block the upper airway during sleep, causing breathing to repeatedly stop and restart. It affects an estimated 1 billion people worldwide and is associated with serious health risks including hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and cognitive impairment.
website.help.faq.q2.q: What are the main warning signs?
website.help.faq.q2.a: The most common signs include loud or frequent snoring, gasping or choking sounds during sleep, excessive daytime sleepiness, morning headaches, dry mouth on waking, and difficulty concentrating. A partner or family member often notices the breathing pauses before the patient does.
website.help.faq.q3.q: How does an oral appliance treat sleep apnea?
website.help.faq.q3.a: A custom-fitted mandibular advancement device (MAD) gently repositions the lower jaw and tongue forward, keeping the upper airway open during sleep. It is worn like a sports mouthguard, requires no mask or machine, and is clinically validated for mild-to-moderate OSA. Many patients find it more comfortable and easier to travel with than CPAP therapy.
website.help.faq.q4.q: When can I expect to see results?
website.help.faq.q4.a: Most patients report noticeable improvements in sleep quality and daytime alertness within the first one to two weeks. Full adaptation to the appliance typically takes two to four weeks. A follow-up appointment at six to eight weeks allows your specialist to fine-tune the fit and confirm treatment efficacy.
website.help.faq.q5.q: How do I join the NeoSleep specialist network?
website.help.faq.q5.a: Any dentist interested in dental sleep medicine is welcome to join — no specialization is required. Complete the contact form on our website and select the 'Professional' option. A member of our team will reach out within two business days to walk you through the onboarding process, training programme, and platform setup. No upfront fees are required to apply.
website.help.faq.q6.q: What training and certification does NeoSleep provide?
website.help.faq.q6.a: We offer a structured dental sleep medicine certification programme covering OSA screening protocols, appliance selection and titration, patient communication, and follow-up care. Existing accreditations (ABDSM, SomnoMed, etc.) are recognised and may reduce the required training hours. Continuing education credits are available upon completion.
website.help.faq.q7.q: How is my personal and health data protected?
website.help.faq.q7.a: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We comply with GDPR (EU), LFPDPPP (Mexico), and PDPA (Thailand). Your health information is only accessible to you and the licensed specialist managing your case. We never sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes.
website.help.faq.q8.q: Can I request deletion of my data?
website.help.faq.q8.a: Yes. You have the right to erasure under GDPR and equivalent laws in other jurisdictions. To submit a deletion request, send an email to info@neosleepcare.com with the subject 'Data Deletion Request'. We will process your request within 30 days and confirm once complete.
website.help.cta.heading: Didn't find your answer?
website.help.cta.subtitle: Our team is ready to help. Send us a message and we'll get back to you shortly.

website.patientsPage.heroSub: Sleep apnea affects millions — silently, relentlessly. NeoSleep connects you with a certified dental specialist who can give you back the rest your body needs.

website.patientsPage.how.step3.title: Sleep better

website.patientsPage.benefits.heading: A smarter alternative to CPAP
A small, comfortable oral appliance worn like a sports guard keeps your airway open silently through the night.
website.patientsPage.benefits.proven.des: Mandibular advancement devices are validated by decades of sleep medicine research for mild-to-moderate OSA.
website.patientsPage.benefits.results.de: Most patients report noticeably better sleep within the first one to two weeks of treatment.
website.patientsPage.benefits.personal.d: Every device is custom-fitted. Every follow-up is tailored to your individual response and comfort.
website.patientsPage.testimonials.1.quot: For the first time in years, I woke up feeling human. The appliance is so much easier than CPAP — I barely notice it's there.
website.patientsPage.testimonials.2.quot: I was sceptical at first — I'd tried CPAP twice and given up both times. After two weeks with the oral appliance my wife said I stopped snoring completely. I haven't slept this well since my twenties.
website.patientsPage.testimonials.3.quot: The whole process was surprisingly smooth. One consultation, a custom fitting, and within a month my AHI dropped from 28 to under 5. My cardiologist was thrilled.

website.patientsPage.cta.sub: Take the first step. Talk to one of our certified specialists today.
